title: Animal Motion Cards
shareTitle: Animal Motion Cards — Hop, Crawl, Waddle & Balance
description: Pick a tactile toy animal card, learn its move in three picture steps, earn paw stamps, and chain favorite motions into a joyful three-animal parade.
learningGoals: Build gross-motor strength, balance, and bilateral coordination
Imitate six distinct animal body shapes from picture and voice cues
Practice safe, self-paced whole-body movement in short playful rounds
Remember and sequence three movements in an animal parade
interactionModel: pick a large animal card, study three modeled poses, then follow three forgiving auto-paced movement beats or advance with the large self-confirm button
feedbackModel: recorded warm-teacher coaching, animated raster poses, tactile sound effects, persistent paw stamps, and a confetti parade finale
